omit.why: The Reader reads the Beatitude troparia between the verses the choir sings; the pew follows them by ear, so neither the book nor the insert prints them (features/beatitudes-print-cues.md). The Reader's copy is the full booklet.

citationsOnly.why: The insert prints reading citations only; the reading itself is heard. Presentation only: the insert DATA still carries the full text, so book + insert = the whole service less the `omit` rule above.
